question.text: Consider circles <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub></math> & <math><msub><mrow><mi>C</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub></math> touching both the axes and passing through <math><mfenced separators="|"><mrow><mn>4,4</mn></mrow></mfenced></math>, then the product of radii of these circles is

solution.text:
Since circle touches both the axes and passes through 4,4, it lies in the first quadrant, so its equation is
x-r2+y-r2=r2
4,4 lies on it hence
r2-16r+32=0
Hence, the product of roots (radii) =32
